# Vercel AI SDK and Next.js brand artwork

These original SVG files come from the official download links on [Vercel’s brand guidelines](https://vercel.com/geist/brands). They are third-party artwork, excluded from SuperIntelligence’s MIT license. Inclusion does not imply endorsement or grant artwork or trademark rights.

- **AI SDK:** `ai-sdk-logotype-light.svg` is the complete light-background wordmark from the [official AI SDK asset archive](https://k2mkucxia43oc7fa.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/front/press/ai-sdk-assets.zip). Its letters, outlined capsule, source color, layout, and proportions are retained. The capsule’s rounded rectangle is converted into an equivalent SVG arc path.
- **Next.js:** `nextjs-icon-light-background.svg` is the compact circle-N mark from the [official Next.js asset archive](https://k2mkucxia43oc7fa.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/front/press/nextjs-assets.zip). Its N path is unchanged; its circle and rectangle use equivalent path geometry. The two white gradient fades are flattened to solid white to meet the collection’s flat-vector requirement, and the redundant circle mask is omitted.

The shared isometric carrier and tonal presentations are unofficial variants. Vercel’s guidelines restrict modification of its marks; use the original downloaded assets when an unmodified brand asset is required. This package does not authorize uses beyond the owner’s guidelines.

Vercel, Next.js, AI SDK, and related logos are trademarks or registered trademarks of Vercel, Inc. or its affiliates. Refer to the linked guidelines for the owner’s full attribution and usage requirements.

`sources.json` records archive URLs, internal filenames, retrieval date, SHA-256 checksums of the original SVG files, and transformations. `src/logos/vercel-platforms.mjs` contains the native geometry used by the renderer.
